initial_application: The request was applied by historical git-svn commit afdd98b34418f93c87ef78ac8e4ca9bfcdbb7822, titled GF#16059 - typo, which records svn revision 14168 and changes source/http.html to the requested syntax.
additional_context: source/http.html is the active RESTful API (HTTP) narrative page linked from source/documentation.html. Jira search for the exact old/new syntax found only FHIR-16059, and Zulip/Confluence searches found only tracker/commit notifications or unrelated Service Base URL discussion with no conflicting later decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current authoritative source already contains the requested brace syntax.
